messages:
Ravi K: Kickoff for EU-staged variant for Partner X. Need canary plan, flag names, rollback gates, and data sharing checklist.
Maya L: Proposal: tiny micro-canary 2% for 2h, regional ramp 20% for 12h, then 60% for 24h before full. Block marketing during windows.
Theo R: Tech: use `px_partnerx.eu.v1` variant pinned to `model-eu-opsafe`. Pre-warm EU pool and set burst +25%.
OpsBot: Reminder: deploy window must have pre-authorized emergency scale (+40%) and a validated kill-switch route to `model-global-fallback`.
Nina P: Telemetry ask from Partner X: per-tenant latency histogram, 5xx rate, and 48h sampled payloads (sanitized). They want daily summaries for first 3 days.
Ravi K: Owners: Product -> telemetry appendix; Eng-Platform -> flag + prewarm; SRE -> SLOs + rollback automation; Legal -> sign payload sharing.
Maya L: Flag naming convention: `partnerx.eu.optin.v{n}`. Canary JSON for Console:
```
{"canary":[{"slice":"rand-2pct","dur":"2h"},{"slice":"eu-20pct","dur":"12h"},{"slice":"eu-60pct","dur":"24h"}],"fallback":"model-global-fallback"}
```
Theo R: Quality gate: if semantic-eval delta >6% or p95 latency degrades >30% over baseline -> auto rollback. SRE to implement.
Nina P: Customer webhook: will accept daily reports at their staging URL. Need API key and rotation every 7 days. Legal: confirm allowed sample retention = 7 days.
LegalBot: Confirmed: 7-day retention for samples, aggregated metrics 90 days. PII must be removed prior to delivery.
Ravi K: Launch checklist (short): create flag, schedule canary, telemetry appendix signed, SLOs and kill-switch tested in staging, webhook + key rotation configured. Signoff by Friday EOD.
Maya L: Ops proposes cutover Monday 07:00 UTC pending signoffs. Please react :thumbsup: to approve.
Theo R: I'll run kill-switch test in staging tomorrow 10:00 UTC and post results.
OpsBot: checkpoint created: canary-plan/partnerx-eu/1758888000 by Ravi K
